newsitem.title: USA: Three killed, two injured in Alaska air crash.
newsitem.headline: Three killed, two injured in Alaska air crash.

text.p: Three people were killed and two seriously injured Monday when their Cessna 206 hydroplane crashed and burst into flames just moments after takeoff from an Anchorage lake.
The hydroplane, operated by Stearns Air Alaska, was going on a sightseeing trip when it crashed into a power line near Lake Hood, Anchorage emergency officials said.
The plane's male pilot and two female passengers were killed in the crash. Two other elderly women were taken to a local hospital suffering from burns, Anchorage fire department dispatchers said.
The victims' names were not released.
All those aboard the plane were from outside Alaska except the pilot, Anchorage television station KTUU reported.
Witnesses told KTUU the plane appeared to lose power before crashing in a fireball.
Investigators from the Federal Aviation Adminstration and the National Transportation Safety Board were sent to the scene late Monday.
